originalTitle: Zoetis (ZTS) Stock Drops Despite Market Gains: Important Facts to Note
summary: Zoetis (ZTS) closed at $71.4 in the latest trading session, marking a -2.22% move from the prior day.
content:
In the latest close session, Zoetis (ZTS) was down 2.22% at $71.40. This change lagged the S&P 500's 0.17% gain on the day. Elsewhere, the Dow saw a downswing of 0.18%, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq appreciated by 0.4%.

The animal health company's shares have seen a decrease of 2.67% over the last month, not keeping up with the Medical sector's gain of 0.65% and the S&P 500's loss of 1.29%.

Investors will be eagerly watching for the performance of Zoetis in its upcoming earnings disclosure. The company's upcoming EPS is projected at $1.52, signifying a 10.59% drop compared to the same quarter of the previous year. In the meantime, our current consensus estimate forecasts the revenue to be $2.31 billion, indicating a 3.66% decline compared to the corresponding quarter of the prior year.

For the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates project earnings of $6.2 per share and a revenue of $9.24 billion, demonstrating changes of -3.28% and -2.45%, respectively, from the preceding year.

Investors should also pay attention to any latest changes in analyst estimates for Zoetis. These revisions typically reflect the latest short-term business trends, which can change frequently. Therefore, positive revisions in estimates convey analysts' confidence in the business performance and profit potential.

Our research shows that these estimate changes are directly correlated with near-term stock prices. To capitalize on this, we've crafted the Zacks Rank, a unique model that incorporates these estimate changes and offers a practical rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, stretching from #1 (Strong Buy) to #5 (Strong Sell), has a noteworthy track record of outperforming, validated by third-party audits, with stocks rated #1 producing an average annual return of +25% since the year 1988. Over the past month, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has shifted 0.09% upward. Zoetis is holding a Zacks Rank of #5 (Strong Sell) right now.

Digging into valuation, Zoetis currently has a Forward P/E ratio of 11.77. This signifies a discount in comparison to the average Forward P/E of 16.09 for its industry.

We can additionally observe that ZTS currently boasts a PEG ratio of 1.7. Comparable to the widely accepted P/E ratio, the PEG ratio also accounts for the company's projected earnings growth. By the end of yesterday's trading, the Medical - Drugs industry had an average PEG ratio of 1.78.

The Medical - Drugs industry is part of the Medical sector. At present, this industry carries a Zacks Industry Rank of 159, placing it within the bottom 36% of over 250 industries.

The Zacks Industry Rank is ordered from best to worst in terms of the average Zacks Rank of the individual companies within each of these sectors. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

chineseTitle: 尽管市场上涨，硕腾 (ZTS) 股价仍下跌：需要注意的重要事实
chineseSummary: Zoetis (ZTS) 在最新交易日收于 71.4 美元，较前一交易日上涨 -2.22%。
chineseContent:
在最近的收盘交易中，硕腾 (ZTS) 下跌 2.22%，至 71.40 美元。这一变化落后于标准普尔 500 指数当日 0.17% 的涨幅。其他方面，道指下跌 0.18%，而以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数则上涨 0.4%。

这家动物保健公司的股价上个月下跌了 2.67%，未能跟上医疗板块 0.65% 的涨幅和标准普尔 500 指数 1.29% 的跌幅。

投资者将热切关注硕腾即将公布的财报中的表现。该公司即将公布的每股收益预计为1.52美元，较去年同期下降10.59%。与此同时，我们目前的共识预测收入为 23.1 亿美元，比去年同期下降 3.66%。

Zacks 一致估计全年每股收益为 6.2 美元，营收为 92.4 亿美元，较上一年分别变化-3.28%和-2.45%。

投资者还应关注分析师对硕腾的预测的最新变化。这些修订通常反映最新的短期业务趋势，这些趋势可能经常变化。因此，预测的积极修正传达了分析师对业务业绩和利润潜力的信心。

我们的研究表明，这些估计变化与近期股价直接相关。为了利用这一点，我们精心设计了 Zacks Rank，这是一个独特的模型，融合了这些估计变化并提供了实用的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统从#1（强力买入）延伸到#5（强力卖出），拥有出色的表现记录，经第三方审计验证，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票产生的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去的一个月里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计向上移动了 0.09%。 Zoetis 目前的 Zacks 排名为#5（强劲销售）。

从估值来看，硕腾目前的远期市盈率为11.77。与该行业 16.09 的平均远期市盈率相比，这意味着存在折扣。

我们还可以观察到，ZTS 目前的 PEG 比率为 1.7。与广泛接受的市盈率相比，PEG 比率也反映了公司的预期盈利增长。截至昨日收盘，医疗药品行业平均PEG率为1.78。

医疗 - 药品行业是医疗部门的一部分。目前，该行业的 Zacks 行业排名为 159，在 250 多个行业中排名垫底 36%。

Zacks 行业排名是根据每个行业内各个公司的平均 Zacks 排名从最好到最差排序的。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
